seo_title: Wheel Spinner – Free Random Picker Wheel
seo_description: Make your own wheel in seconds: enter names or options, spin, and let the wheel pick at random. Set the weight and color of each entry and share your wheel with a link. Free, no sign-up, works on mobile.
